actor_training: LoRA r32 alpha64 on attention and MLP projections
learning_rate_note: Provisional selection from a small, noisy 4B DeepScaleR pilot; held fixed across methods and seeds.
full_critic: Separate fully trainable BF16 critic with FP32 CPU Adam master weights and optimizer state; 2 GPUs per job.
evaluation: Greedy at 1M, 5M and 10M generated training tokens; MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, AMC 2023 and a scoreable Minerva subset.
screening: 1000 independently sampled candidate problems, eight independent rollouts each; retain 2–6 successes of 8; at least 128 problems required; exclude reward-pilot prompts.
training_comparison_note: Report reward-screening cost, generated tokens, GPU-hours, peak memory, uncertainty across seeds and benchmarks; no claim that likelihood mismatch is corrected.
rollout_mismatch: Rollout engine and full-sequence training logits are not exactly identical; pilot measured approximately 0.7–0.8% tokens with absolute ratio deviation above 20%, without correction.
